grammar.title: Present Simple: Daily Routines and Timetables
grammar.explain_en: We use the Present Simple to talk about things we do regularly, like daily routines and school timetables. We often use adverbs of frequency like 'always', 'usually', 'often', 'sometimes', 'never' or time expressions like 'every day', 'on Mondays'.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng thì Hiện tại Đơn để nói về những điều chúng ta làm thường xuyên, như thói quen hàng ngày và thời khóa biểu ở trường. Chúng ta thường dùng các trạng từ chỉ tần suất như 'always', 'usually', 'often', 'sometimes', 'never' hoặc các cụm từ chỉ thời gian như 'every day', 'on Mondays'.
examples: I go to school every weekday.
She has Maths on Tuesday mornings.
We usually have lunch at 11:30.
My English class starts at 8:00.
grammar.right: ✅ I always study English on Monday.
grammar.wrong: ❌ I am always studying English on Monday.

grammar.title: Prepositions of Time: on, at, in
grammar.explain_en: We use 'on' for specific days and dates. We use 'at' for specific times. We use 'in' for parts of the day (morning, afternoon, evening) and months/seasons.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng 'on' cho các ngày và ngày cụ thể. Chúng ta dùng 'at' cho các thời điểm cụ thể. Chúng ta dùng 'in' cho các buổi trong ngày (sáng, chiều, tối) và các tháng/mùa.
examples: On Monday, I have Science.
My class starts at 9 o'clock.
I play with friends in the afternoon.
We have a holiday in July.

grammar.title: Asking about Plans: What will you do...?
grammar.explain_en: We use 'What will you do...?' to ask about future plans or intentions, especially for the near future like the weekend or later today. The answer often uses 'I will...' or 'I'm going to...'.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng 'What will you do...?' để hỏi về các kế hoạch hoặc dự định trong tương lai, đặc biệt là tương lai gần như cuối tuần hoặc chiều nay. Câu trả lời thường dùng 'I will...' hoặc 'I'm going to...'.
examples: What will you do this weekend? I will visit my grandparents.
What will she do tomorrow? She will go to the library.
What will we do after school? We will play games.
grammar.right: ✅ What will you do on Sunday? I will go swimming.
grammar.wrong: ❌ What do you do on Sunday? I will go swimming.

grammar.title: Talking about Ability: Can / Cannot
grammar.explain_en: We use 'can' to say that we are able to do something. We use 'cannot' (or 'can't') to say that we are not able to do something. This is useful when talking about subjects or activities.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng 'can' để nói rằng chúng ta có thể làm điều gì đó. Chúng ta dùng 'cannot' (hoặc 'can't') để nói rằng chúng ta không thể làm điều gì đó. Điều này hữu ích khi nói về các môn học hoặc hoạt động.
examples: I can draw well in Art class.
She can speak English fluently.
He can't play the piano, but he can sing.
We can solve difficult Maths problems.
grammar.right: ✅ I can run fast in PE.
grammar.wrong: ❌ I can to run fast in PE.

readings.title: MY FAVORITE SCHOOL DAY
readings.text:
Hello! My name is Linh. I am nine years old. I go to Green Hill Primary School. I love my school week, but my favorite day is Friday. 

On Friday mornings, I have English and Music. English is my favorite subject because I can learn new words and songs. My teacher, Ms. Hoa, makes it fun! In Music class, we sing and play simple instruments. I can play the recorder a little bit. 

In the afternoon, we have PE. I love running and playing games with my friends. After school, I usually go home and help my mom. Then I play with my dog, Lucky. Friday is a busy day, but it's also the start of the weekend, so it's the best!

readings.title: MINH'S SCHOOL TIMETABLE
readings.text:
Hi, I'm Minh! I'm in Grade 4. My school starts at 7:30 AM every day from Monday to Friday. Our timetable is always busy, but I enjoy learning new things. 

On Mondays, we start with Vietnamese Literature, then Maths. In the afternoon, we have Social Studies and Art. Art is very relaxing. On Tuesdays, my favorite class is Science. We do cool experiments! After Science, we have English. Our English teacher, Mr. David, teaches us many fun games. 

Wednesday is a bit different. We have PE in the morning, which I love because I can run and play with my friends. Then we have Music. In the afternoon, we have more Maths and some extra reading time in the library. My school week is full of activities, and I always look forward to the next lesson!

readings.title: A WEEK OF DISCOVERIES
readings.text:
This is a special week at Hoa Mai Primary School! The students in Grade 4 are having a 'Week of Discoveries', where they explore different topics and do fun activities every day. 

On Monday, they had a 'Science Day'. They built small robots and learned about how plants grow. Nam said, 'It was amazing! We even saw tiny seeds sprout.' Tuesday was 'Art and Music Day'. The children painted beautiful pictures and composed their own short songs. Mia, a student from Grade 4B, proudly showed her painting of a vibrant flower garden. 

Wednesday was 'Sports and Games Day'. Everyone played football, basketball, and invented new team games. 'I was tired but very happy,' said Tom. Thursday was 'History and Geography Day'. They learned about ancient Vietnamese heroes and drew maps of their city. Today is Friday, and it's 'Future Dreams Day'. The students are writing about what they want to be when they grow up and sharing their dreams with the class. They will also make posters about their dream jobs. 

This 'Week of Discoveries' helps students learn in a fun way and discover new talents. Every day is an adventure, and they are all excited for the next one!

listening.script: Hello, I'm Ms. Lan, your teacher. Today, I want to tell you about our special school activities for this week. On Monday morning, we will have our regular English class, but in the afternoon, we will have a guest speaker talking about healthy eating habits. Please bring a small fruit for a snack! On Tuesday, we have our Maths and Science classes as usual. In Science, we'll start a new project about plants. Don't forget your notebooks! Wednesday is our 'Talent Show Practice' day. If you want to sing, dance, or tell a story, come to the school hall after lunch. On Thursday, we will have a special History lesson with a visit to the school museum. It will be very interesting! Finally, on Friday, we will have our big PE sports day in the morning, and in the afternoon, we will watch a movie together to celebrate a great week. I hope you all have a fantastic week!

life_skill.title: MANAGE YOUR TIME WELL
life_skill.intro: Time is very important! Managing your time well means you use your time wisely to do schoolwork, play, and rest. This helps you be successful and happy.
life_skill.intro_vi: Thời gian rất quan trọng! Quản lý thời gian tốt có nghĩa là bạn sử dụng thời gian một cách khôn ngoan để làm bài tập, vui chơi và nghỉ ngơi. Điều này giúp bạn thành công và hạnh phúc.

fun_facts.en: Did you know? The names of the days of the week come from ancient Roman and Norse gods and planets!
fun_facts.vi: Bạn có biết không? Tên các ngày trong tuần bắt nguồn từ các vị thần và hành tinh của La Mã và Bắc Âu cổ đại!

fun_facts.en: Did you know? There are exactly 168 hours in one week.
fun_facts.vi: Bạn có biết không? Có chính xác 168 giờ trong một tuần.

fun_facts.en: Did you know? The shortest school week in the world is in France, where primary school children often have Wednesdays off!
fun_facts.vi: Bạn có biết không? Tuần học ngắn nhất thế giới là ở Pháp, nơi học sinh tiểu học thường được nghỉ vào thứ Tư!

fun_facts.en: Did you know? In some countries, the weekend is on Friday and Saturday, not Saturday and Sunday!

fun_facts.en: Did you know? The word 'timetable' comes from the combination of 'time' and 'table'.

classroom_game.name: Timetable Bingo
steps_en: Each student draws a 3x3 grid on a piece of paper.
Students write 9 different school subjects or daily activities (e.g., English, Maths, PE, lunch, play games) in their grid.
The teacher calls out a day of the week and a subject/activity (e.g., 'On Monday, English!').
If a student has that subject/activity in their grid, they cross it out. The first student to get 3 in a row (horizontally, vertically, or diagonally) shouts 'Bingo!' and wins.
steps_vi: Mỗi học sinh vẽ một bảng 3x3 trên một tờ giấy.
Học sinh viết 9 môn học hoặc hoạt động hàng ngày khác nhau (ví dụ: Tiếng Anh, Toán, Thể dục, ăn trưa, chơi trò chơi) vào bảng của mình.
Giáo viên gọi tên một ngày trong tuần và một môn học/hoạt động (ví dụ: 'Vào thứ Hai, môn Tiếng Anh!').
Nếu học sinh có môn học/hoạt động đó trong bảng của mình, hãy gạch bỏ. Học sinh đầu tiên có 3 ô liên tiếp (ngang, dọc hoặc chéo) hô to 'Bingo!' và thắng cuộc.
